text:
DCE iron ore futures rose largely today by 2.83%. Traders ship according to market condtions；steel mills inquiries decreased, resulting in poor purchasing enthusiasm. PBF at Shandong port dealt 1062-1065 yuan/mt; increased 12-15 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 1085 yuan/mt; increased 17 yuan/mt over yesterday. According to the weekly blast furnace maintenance data tracked by SMM, 9 blast furnaces were repaired and 15 blast furnaces were resumed production in this cycle; The operating rate of the blast furnace according to statistics is 88.7%, an increase of 0.59% compared to last week. The utilization rate of blast furnace production capacity was 89.02%, an increase of 0.81% compared to the previous period. The daily average iron production of the sample steel plant was 2.1317 million tons, an increase of 21200 tons compared to the previous period. Stacked with replenishment support, the overall demand for iron ore is strong. On a macro level, the net increase of PSL350 billion by the three major banks in December, coupled with Shanghai's adjustment of housing provident fund loan policies, remains relatively warm. However, considering the seasonal offseason and steel mill losses or the suppression of ore prices, it is expected that ore prices will fluctuate at high levels in the short term.

DCE iron ore futures fall by 1.38 in the today. the main contract I2405 closed 1000. Some traders adoptseparate quotations. Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchased on demand. total transactions remained insipid. PBF at Shandong port dealt 1045-1050 yuan/mt; decreased 10-15 yuan/mt over yesterday. SSF at Tangshan port dealt 940 yuan/mt; decreased 5 yuan/mt over yesterday. As of January 5th, SMM has tracked a total of 119.31 million tons of inventory in 35 ports, with a cumulative inventory of 2.41 million tons compared to last week; The daily average port clearance volume of imported ore in this period increased by 78000 tons on a weekly basis to 2.937 million tons. This week, port clearance continued to increase, but the growth rate slowed down. This is mainly due to the demand for restocking in steel mills near the Spring Festival. However, the current iron ore price is relatively high, and the pace of restocking is slow. Looking ahead next week, pre holiday restocking may drive an increase in transaction volume, while mining prices still have support and are expected to fluctuate at high levels.

DCE iron ore futures open higher and go lower, futures market falling trends today; the main contract I2405 closed992.5. some traders were negative to sell; Some steel procurement more cautious, the continuation of a small number of multi-frequency procurement strategy. PBF at Shandong port dealt 1040-1043 yuan/mt; decreased 2-10 yuan/mt from last Friday. SMM's global iron ore shipments totaled 29.08 million tons, a significant decrease of 18.1% compared to the previous month. Both Australia and Brazil experienced a significant decline in shipping volume. Affected by domestic pressure on ports, the total amount of arrivals was 25.2047 million tons, a significant decrease of 10.27% compared to the previous month. The surge of overseas mines has basically ended and will return to normal levels in the later stage. But the arrival volume may continue to be high. The overall supply remains loose. On the one hand, the demand is due to the approaching Spring Festival, and on the other hand, terminal demand continues to weaken. Some steel mills have added blast furnace maintenance plans, resulting in low iron production. However, considering that there is still support for replenishing inventory before the Spring Festival, short-term mining prices may continue to fluctuate.

DCE iron ore futures fall today by 0.25%. the main contract I2405 closed 994. Traders ship according to marketconditions; Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchased on demand. PBF at Shandong port dealt 1040-1043 yuan/mt; the same as yesterday; PBF at Tangshan port dealt 1060 yuan/mt; the same as yesterday; According to the blast furnace maintenance data tracked and researched by SMM yesterday, as the Spring FesƟval approaches and steel mills experience losses, some steel mills have increased their blast furnace maintenance plans. This week (January 6th to January 12th), the impact of blast furnace maintenance on molten iron was 2.1247 million tons, an increase of 37700 tons compared to last week's maintenance. This week's molten iron production reached a new low in the second half of the year. The demand for iron ore has declined. The pace of steel mills replenishing inventory before the holiday is relatively slow, and spot transactions continue to be low. The mining price fluctuates weakly. Recently, winter storage policies for steel mills have been gradually released, with a focus on winter storage replenishment and financial data in the later stage.

DCE iron ore futures open higher and go lower, futures fall today by 1.76%. the main contract I2405 closed 948.5.some traders were negative to sell, Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchased on demand. today's overall market transaction atmosphere in general. PBF at Shandong port dealt 1018-1025 yuan/mt; decreased 5-12 yuan/mt over yesterday; PBF at Tangshan port dealt 1040 yuan/mt; decreased 5 yuan/mt over yesterday; The total inventory of 35 ports tracked by SMM is 122.85 million tons, with a month on month accumulation of 3.54 million tons; 7.34 million tons of inventory were removed year-on-year; The daily average port clearance volume of imported ore in this period increased by 64000 tons to 3.001 million tons on a weekly basis. The continued increase in port clearance indicates an increase in the procurement volume of steel mills, which will continue to replenish their inventory. But currently, the accumulation of inventory in ports is relatively large, and the production of molten iron is low, which weakens the support for mineral prices. The opinions on building a beautiful China have had an impact on sentiment, and iron ore prices continue to decline.

DCE iron ore futures market falling trends by 3.17. the main contract I2405 closed 933.Traders ship according to market conditions；Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchased on demand. total transactions remained insipid. PBF at Shandong port dealt 997-1018 yuan/mt; decreased 0-21 yuan/mt from last Friday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 1024-1035 yuan/mt; decreased 5-16 yuan/mt from last Friday. SMM's global iron ore shipments totaled 30.06 million tons, a slight increase of 3.4% compared to the previous month. The shipment volume from Australia and Brazil has slightly increased, but the proportion of shipments to China has decreased, and it is expected that the arrival volume from China will decline. The arrival volume in this cycle has significantly increased by 13.55% to a high of 2861.88. Loose supply suppresses ore prices, coupled with today's market expectation of MLF not falling as expected, resulitng in a significant downward pressure on ore prices. Short term iron ore prices may still be weakly affected by macroeconomic data and fluctuate.

DCE iron ore futures tight by 0.64%, the main contract I2405 closed 938.5. some traders were negative to sell；Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchased on demand. total transactions remained insipid. PBF at Shandong port dealt 998-1002 yuan/mt; the sameas yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 100 yuan/mt; decreased 4 yuan/mt over yesterday. According to SMM statistics, this week (January 13th to January 19th), the impact of blast furnace maintenance on molten iron was 2.004 million tons, a decrease of 104500 tons compared to last week's maintenance. The impact of blast furnace maintenance on molten iron next week (January 20th to January 26th) is 1.9282 million tons, a decrease of 75800 tons compared to this week. With the resumption of production after the completion of some blast furnace maintenance, the number of newly repaired blast furnaces has decreased, and the molten iron has begun to recover. The demand for iron ore has slightly increased, and the price decline has narrowed.

text:
The iron ore future price continued to shake down today, the main contract I2405 closed at 925, down 1.33%throughout the day. Iron ore spot price in the morning rose slightly 2-3 yuan/mt or so, but the inquiry was relatively less. Some steel mills continued the rhythm of just needing to purchase, the actual transaction is limited throughout the day, and the trading sentiment was weak. PBF in the Shandong region quoted at 1005 yuan/mt in the morning, which was changed limited from yesterday; PBF at Tangshan early morning offered at 1015-1020 yuan/mt or so, up 0-5 yuan/mt from yesterday. According to SMM research, the blast furnace operating rate of domestic steel mills is 88.11%, which is unchanged from the last week. The utilization rate of blast furnace capacity was 89.11%, up 0.3% from the previous period. The average daily output of pig iron at the sample steel mill was 2.13Mt, an increase of 0.72Mt from the previous month. Although this week's blast furnace maintenance impact has declined, the macro sentiment is oriented, the overall spot market transaction is weak, and iron ore prices are expected to continue weak shocks in the short term.

The iron ore future price continued to fluctuate within a narrow range today, with the main contract I2405closing at 948.5, up 2.43% throughout the day. The spot price of imported ore ports in early trading increased by 5-10 yuan/mt compared with yesterday, and market trading sentiment has improved compared with yesterday. The transaction price of PBF in Shandong is around 985-1010yuan/mt, and the transaction price of PBF in the Tangshan area is around 1010yuan/mt, which is 10 yuan/mt higher than yesterday. According to SMM port inventory data, port inventories are still accumulating this week; port inventories at the national top ten main ports once again accumulated 1.02 million mt to 89.89 million mt from last week. Among them, crude fine and pellets are accumulated, while concentrate and lump iron ore are depleted. The profits of steel mills have mostly remained at low levels, but some steel mills have begun to take action to replenish their stocks before the Spring Festival holiday. Some steel mills have not yet started restocking depending on the price performance of iron ore. However, as subsequent steel mills begin to replenish their inventories, port inventory accumulation is expected to slow down, which will provide some bottom support for iron ore prices.

DCE iron ore futures rose largely today by 2.63%. the main contract I2405 closed 957. some traderswere negative to sell；Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchased on demand. today's overall market transaction atmosphere in general. PBF at Shandong port dealt 1000-1012 yuan/mt; increased 10 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 1010 yuan/mt; the same as yesterday. As of January 19, 2024, SMM has tracked a total of 123.27 million tons of inventory in 35 ports, with a month on month accumulation of 430000 tons and a year-on-year accumulation of 5.16 million tons; The daily average port clearance of imported ore in this period increased by 59000 tons month on month to 3.06 million tons, a decrease of 53000 tons year-on-year. Recently, there has been a significant decline in iron ore prices, coupled with the recovery of steel mill profits. Some steel mills have accelerated their replenishment pace, which has led to an increase in port dredging. Considering that the replenishment is coming to an end, although there is still an expectation of an increase in molten iron production, it is difficult to have a significant increase in overall demand, and it is expected that mining prices will continue to fluctuate within a narrow range.

DCE iron ore futures tight with 0.53%. the main contract I2405 closed 952. Traders ship according to market conditions；steel mills purchased on demand. today's overall market transaction atmosphere in general. PBF at Shandong port dealt 1010-1012 yuan/mt; the same as last Friday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 1025 yuan/mt; increased 10-15 yuan/mt from last Friday. According to SMM shipping data, global shipping volume has declined, and the weekly shipping volume in the later period may be difficult to exceed 30 million tons. In terms of arrival volume, there has also been a significant decrease in this cycle. As the shipping volume decreases, it is expected that the arrival volume at the port will remain at a moderate level. From the perspective of different varieties arriving at the port, the reduction in coarse powder is relatively large, while the reduction in fine powder is minimal. The price difference of high school products may narrow in the future. Overall, the impact on mineral prices remains relatively weak. Mainly focusing on the impact of macroeconomic policies and news, in the short term, iron ore prices may experience narrow fluctuations.

DCE iron ore futures open lower and go higher, the main contract I2405 closed 965.5. an increase of6.48% throughout the day. Some traders adopt separate quotations. Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchasing enthusiasm is not high. today's overall market transaction atmosphere in general. PBF at Shandong port dealt 1017-1018 yuan/mt; increased 6-7 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 1035 yuan/mt; increased 10 yuan/mt over yesterday. According to SMM statistics, this week (January 20th to January 26th), the impact of blast furnace maintenance on molten iron was 1.9889 million tons, a decrease of 35800 tons compared to last week's maintenance. The impact of blast furnace maintenance on molten iron next week (January 27th to February 2nd) is 1.9525 million tons, a decrease of 36400 tons compared to this week. The production of molten iron continues to slightly recover. The global shipping volume of iron ore has declined, and the fundamental support for iron ore has strengthened. Considering the current weak industrial chain, macro news has a significant impact on prices, and short-term iron ore prices may continue to fluctuate.

DCE iron ore futures tight by 0.1%; the main contract I2405 closed 989.5. some traders were negative to sell,Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchasing enthusiasm is not high. total transactions remained insipid. PBF at Shandong port dealt 1026-1030 yuan/mt; decreased 5-10 yuan/mt over yesterday. As of January 26th, the total inventory of 35 ports tracked by SMM was 124.62 million tons, an increase of 1.35 million tons month on month and a decrease of 9.02 million tons year-on-year; The daily average port clearance volume of imported ore is 2.933 million tons, a decrease of 127000 tons compared to the previous week. There has been a slight decrease in port clearance this week. Firstly, due to the completion of pre holiday replenishment by steel mills, procurement has significantly slowed down; Furthermore, some ports along the river are affected by strong winds, resulting in significant reductions in port clearance; With the end of pre holiday storage in steel mills, the volume of port clearance will continue to decline. Considering that the macro outlook remains optimistic in the later stage, it is expected that mining prices will continue to fluctuate at high levels.

DCE iron ore futures rose largely today; the main contract I2405 closed 998.5. Traders ship according to market conditions.Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchasing enthusiasm is not high. total transactions remained insipid. PBF at Shandong port dealt 1035 yuan/mt; increased 5 yuan/mt from last Friday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 1037yuan/mt; increased 0-5 yuan/mt from last Friday. According to SMM shipping data, the total global iron ore shipments last week were 31.82 million tons, an increase of 18.7% compared to the previous week. Among them, 17.44 million tons were shipped from Australia, an increase of 16.8% compared to the previous period; Australia sends 13.27 million tons to China, and the proportion of shipments to China has increased. However, due to the previous decrease in global shipping volume, the arrival volume at the port in this period conƟnued to decline by 2.38% month on month. According to the maintenance data of SMM blast furnace, it is expected that there will still be a slight increase in molten iron this week, but the pre holiday replenishment of steel plants has basically ended, and the overall demand for iron ore is stable, with little supply-demand contradiction. Mainly focusing on the impact of macroeconomic policies and news, it is expected that iron ore will continue to fluctuate at high levels.

DCE iron ore futures open higher and go lower, ﬂuctuate by 1.76% in a day. the main contract I2405closed 979.5. some traders were negative to sell； Some steel mills purchased on demand. total transactions is poor. PBF at Shandong port dealt 1021- 1025 yuan/mt; decreased 10-14 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 1040-1030 yuan/mt; decreased 0-10 yuan/mt over yesterday. Recently, macro bullish policies have driven market sentiment towards optimism, coupled with a slight increase in molten iron production, driving continuous increases in ore prices and squeezing steel mill profits. The terminal demand is in the oﬀ-season, and the poor demand for finished products is suppressing the rise in mining prices. In the short term, there is no major contradiction in the fundamentals of iron ore. Pay attention to PMI data and the impact of the Federal Reserve's interest rate meeting.

DCE iron ore futures market falling sharply trends by 3.08%. the main contract I2405 closed 960.5.Some traders adopt separate quotations. and Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchasing enthusiasm is not high. total transactions remained insipid. PBF at Shandong port dealt 1007-1014 yuan/mt; decreased 10-15 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 1040-1030 yuan/mt; decreased 0-10 yuan/mt over yesterday. The operating rate of blast furnaces tracked by SMM remained stable this week, with a month on month increase of 3800 tons/day in molten iron production. But as the end of the year approaches, most steel mills have already completed restocking, and only some steel mills near the port still have a small demand for restocking; Weakening support for iron ore prices. The short-term macro benefits have been exhausted, and market sentiment has turned negative, causing iron ore prices to fluctuate and decline. Considering that there will still be a certain increase in molten iron in the future, and overseas shipments are entering the off-season, which will provide some support for ore prices, it is expected that iron ore prices will face a dilemma of upward and downward fluctuatiƟons, with continued volatility as the main trend.

DCE iron ore futures tight，the main contract I2405 closed 960.5. an decrease of 0.36% throughout the day;some traders were negative to sell, Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchasing enthusiasm is not high. total transactions is poor. PBF at Shandong port dealt 1003-108 yuan/mt; decreased 5 yuan/mt over yesterday. SSF at Tangshan port dealt 892 yuan/mt; the same as yesterday. The PMI data for January performed reasonably well, in line with market expectations. In addition, the apparent demand for building materials continues to decline significantly today, and inventory accumulation continues to increase month on month. Considering the recent nationwide rain and snow weather, it is expected that the demand for building materials will continue to decline. Terminal demand is at a low level, and inventory accumulation pressure is increasing. As the end of the year approaches, the steel mills have basically completed their replenishment, and the short-term support for ore prices is weak, which may continue to fluctuate weakly.

DCE iron ore futures open higher and go lower, roseing sharply trends in the day. the main contract I2405closed 941. an decrease of 2.23% throughout the day; part of the business quotation shipping mentality turn weak. Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchasing enthusiasm is not high. total transactions remained insipid. PBF at Shandong port dealt 985 yuan/mt; decreased 15-20 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 995 yuan/mt; decreased 15-20 yuan/mt over yesterday. As of February 2nd, the total inventory of 35 ports tracked by SMM was 126.26 million tons, an increase of 1.64 million tons month on month and a decrease of 9.05 million tons year-on-year; The daily average port clearance volume of imported ore is 2.938 million tons, an increase of 5000 tons month on month and 411000 tons year-on-year. As the Spring Festival approaches, some steel mills that have not completed replenishment have accelerated their pace. Overall, the daily average port clearance volume has slightly increased, with a more significant increase in port clearance in North and East China regions; Overall, due to a significant increase in arrivals, port inventory remains in a state of accumulation. Next week, on the eve of the Spring Festival, steel mills will end restocking and market transactions will soon come to a halt. Mineral prices may continue to fluctuate narrowly.

DCE iron ore futures fall today; the main contract I2405 closed 943. As the Spring Fesτιval approaches,some traders have already closed down. And the pre holiday restocking of steel mills has basically ended, with fewer inquiries and almost stagnant market transacτιons.. PBF at Shandong port dealt 985 yuan/mt; the same as last Friday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 985-995 yuan/mt; the same as last Friday. According to SMM shipping data, the total global iron ore shipments last week were 28.58 million tons, a decrease of 10.2% compared to the previous week. Among them, 15.69 million tons were shipped from Australia, a decrease of 10% compared to the previous period; Australia sends 12.65 million tons to China, and the proporτιon of shipments to China has increased. The arrival volume in this period was 26.31 million tons, an increase of 3.28% compared to the previous period. On the demand side, there may be a decline with the end of pre holiday storage in steel mills. Short term loose supply suppresses mining prices. It is expected that short-term mining prices may conτιnue to fluctuate weakly.

DCE iron ore futures continued to ﬂuctuate in a day by 0.63%. As the Spring Festival approaches, coupled withweak market perfor- mance, the enthusiasm of traders to oﬀer is poor. However, steel mills mainly rely on observation and have not yet learned about market transactions. PBF at Shandong port quoted 980 yuan/mt; the same as yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port quoted 990 yuan/mt; the same as yesterday. According to SMM statistics, this week (February 3rd to February 9th), the impact of blast furnace maintenance on molten iron was 1.7669 million tons, a decrease of 96600 tons compared to last week's maintenance. The impact of blast furnace maintenance on molten iron next week (February 10th to February 16th) is 1.69 million tons, a decrease of 76900 tons compared to this week. There is still room for an increase in the production of molten iron in the future, while overseas transportation has declined, and there is not much contradiction in the fundamentals of iron ore. It is expected that iron ore prices will remain weak and stable before the Spring Festival.

DCE iron ore futures open higher and go lower, fluctuate tight by 0.52% in a day. the maincontract I2405 closed 951.5. On the first opening day after the Spring Festival, the market was weak and traders showed average enthusiasm for shipping. Steel mills are also mostly wait-and-see, and overall market transactions are poor. PBF at Shandong port dealt 994 yuan/mt; decreased 21 yuan/mt over yesterday. According to SMM shipping data, the total global iron ore shipment was 29.61 million tons, an increase of 9% compared to the previous month. Both Australia and Brazil saw a month on month increase in shipments. The arrival volume is 28.92 million tons. However, terminal demand is still in the off-season, with delayed resumption of blast furnace production in steel mills, slow increase in molten iron.

DCE iron ore futures market falling sharply trends by 5.41%. the main contract I2405 closed 909.5.Some traders adopt separate quotations; Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchased on demand. today's overall market transaction atmosphere in general. PBF at Shandong port dealt 971 yuan/mt; decreased 23 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 975 yuan/mt; decreased 30 yuan/mt over yesterday. According to SMM statistics, this week (February 17th to February 23rd), the impact of blast furnace maintenance on molten iron was 1.7506 million tons, an increase of 52600 tons compared to last week's maintenance. The impact of blast furnace maintenance on molten iron next week (February 24th to March 1st) is 1.7246 million tons, a decrease of 26000 tons compared to this week.

DCE iron ore futures continued to fall in a day. the main contract I2405 closed 893.an decrease of 3.98% throughout the day; some traders were negative to sell, Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchasing enthusiasm is not high. total transactions is poor. PBF at Shandong port dealt 945-950 yuan/mt; decreased 10-15 yuan/mt over yesterday. The latest statistics from SMM show that the operating rate of blast furnaces is 88.7%, a decrease of 0.3% compared to the previous period. The utilization rate of blast furnace producƟon capacity is 90.2%, a decrease of 0.18% compared to the previous period. The daily average iron production of the sample steel plant was 2.1559 million tons, a decrease of 0.66 million tons compared to the previous period. The demand for iron ore has slightly declined.

DCE iron ore futures tight, and rosed in the end. the main contract I2405 closed 890. an decrease of 0.11% throughoutthe day; Market wait-and-see sentiment increased; Some traders adopt separate quotations; Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchasing enthusiasm is not high. total transactions remained insipid. PBF at Shandong port dealt 900-905 yuan/mt; increased 10-15 yuan/mt from last Friday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 910-915 yuan/mt; decreased 10-20 yuan/mt from last Friday. SMM's global iron ore shipments totaled 30.68 million tons, an increase of 4.3% month on month. Among them, Australia shipped 15.13 million tons, a decrease of 9.2% month on month; Brazil shipped 8.19 million tons, an increase of 25% compared to the previous month; The arrival volume in China was 28.16 million tons.

DCE iron ore futures open lower and go higher, futures in the day by1.83%. the main contract I2405 closed 890.Some traders were active to sell,；Some steel procurement more cautious, the continuation of a small number of multifrequency procurement strategy. total transactions remained insipid. PBF at Shandong port dealt 893-898 yuan/mt; increased 0-3 yuan/mt over yesterday. SSF at Shandong port dealt 760 yuan/mt; increased 13 yuan/mt over yesterday. Based on the inventory data of the top ten main port iron ore varieties tracked by SMM, the port inventory remained in an accumulated state this week. Affected by environmental protection and production restrictions, the demand for lump has increased, and inventory is showing a state of destocking; finesconcentrate, and pellets show.

DCE iron ore futures fall today，the main contract closed 831.5，an decrease of 2.23% throughout the day;The shortterm bearish sentiment in the market is strong, and the mentality of merchants in quoting has weakened, often following the market trend; Steel mills have fewer inquiries and mainly focus on on-demand procurement. The overall transaction volume in the market is relatively quiet, with PB powder trading at a price of 830-840 yuan/ton in Shandong region and 835-845 yuan/ton in Tangshan region, which is basically stable compared to yesterday. According to SMM statistics, this week (March 9th to March 15th), the impact of blast furnace maintenance on molten iron was 1.9473 million tons, an increase of 137500 tons compared to last week's maintenance. PBF at Shandong port dealt 780-805 yuan/mt; increased 10-15 yuan/mt from last Friday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 795-810 yuan/mt; increased 0-10 yuan/mt from last Friday. SMM's global iron ore shipments totaled 29.65 million tons, a decrease of 2.6% compared to the previous month. Among them, 18.37 million tons were shipped from Australia, a decrease of 0.9% month on month; Australia shipped 15.11 million tons to China, accounting for 82.2% of the total shipment to Australia, an increase of 4.1% month on month. In Shandong, the transaction price for PB powder is in the range of 830-835 yuan/ton, while in Tangshan, the transaction price is 840-845 yuan/ton, representing an increase of 15-20 yuan/ton compared to the previous day. DCE iron ore futures market falling trends. The main contract, I2405 closed at 805.5, an decrease of 3.53% throughout the day; some traderswere negative to sell; Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchasing enthusiasm is not high. In Shandong region, long-distance transactions are mainly conducted, while spot transactions are temporarily not available. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 811 yuan/mt; decreased 10 yuan/mt over yesterday. According to SMM research, on March 27, the blast furnace operating rate was 89.60%, up 0.15% month-on-month. DCE iron ore futures first fell and then rose. The main contract I2409 closed at 768, an increase of 2.61% throughout the day;Traders are actively shipping, while steel mills are cautious and mainly purchasing on demand. The overall market atmosphere today is average. PBF at Shandong port dealt 779 yuan/mt; increased 20 yuan/mt From last Friday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 768-798 yuan/mt; increased 0-20 yuan/mt From last Friday. Based on the latest shipping data from SMM, the total global iron ore shipping volume last week was 33.83 million tons, an increase of 12.3% compared to the previous week. Both Australia and Brazil saw significant increases in shipping volume. The total amount of iron ore arriving in Chinese ports was 23.30 million tons, a decrease of 4.13% compared to the previous week.

DCE iron ore futures market rose by 3.09% . The main contract I2409 closed at 768; Traders ship according to market conditions；steel mills purchased on demand. Today the overall market transaction atmosphere is acceptable. PBF at Shandong port dealt 779-780 yuan/mt; the same as yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 790 yuan/mt; the same as yesterday. According to SMM statistics, the impact of blast furnace maintenance on molten iron production this week (March 30th to April 5th) was 1.8694 million tons, a decrease of 82.7 thousand tons compared to the previous week. The estimated impact for next week (April 6th to April 12th) is 1.7563 million tons, a further decrease of 113.1 thousand tons compared to this week. Molten iron production is gradually recovering. Considering the recent meeting called.

PBF at Tangshan port dealt 790 yuan/mt; decreased 0-5 yuan/mt over yesterday. DCE iron ore futures continued to fluctuate in a day,the main contract closed 813.5, an increase of 1.43% throughout the day. Tradingcompanies generally ship on demand, with fewer inquiries from steel mills and overall market transactions leaning towards being quiet. In Shandong, the transaction price for PB powder is in the range of 825-830 yuan/ton, while mainstream coke powder is at 930-935 yuan/ton, with transaction prices remaining relatively stable compared to yesterday. According to SMM research, on April 10th, the blast furnace operating rate was 90.35%, up 0.3% from the previous period. The blast furnace capacity utilization rate was 91.34%, up 0.17% from the previous period. The average daily pig iron production of sample steel mills was 2.1833 million tons, up by 0.42 million tons.

DCE iron ore futures rose largely today, the main contract closed 826, an increase of 1.29% throughout the day。Traders are generally active inshipping, while steel mills are more hesitant and still mainly purchasing on demand. The overall market trading atmosphere is average. In Shandong province, the transaction prices for powder metallurgy iron (PB powder) are 825-830 yuan per ton and for ultrafine iron powder are 660-665 yuan, with prices rising slightly by 1-5 yuan compared to yesterday. From today's apparent steel data, downstream demand has shown some improvement, combined with the increase in blast furnace iron production at current steel mills, which may lead to increased demand for iron powder and provide some support for prices. It is expected that in the near future, the price of iron ore may.

DCE iron ore futures today, and experienced a significant increase in the afternoon.The main contract I2409 closed at 870, with a daily increase of 4.25%. Traders are actively selling, while steel mills are cautious and have reduced their inquiries. Overall, the market has a good trading atmosphere today. PBF at Shandong port dealt 875-888 yuan/mt; increased 30-40 yuan/mt over yesterday. According to SMM research, on April 17th, the blast furnace operating rate calculated by SMM was 90.94%, up 0.59% from the previous period. The blast furnace capacity utilization rate was 91.95%, up 0.61% from the previous period. The daily average pig iron production of sample steel mills was 2.1979 million tons, an increase of 14.6 thousand tons from the previous period. It is estimated that there will be more.

DCE iron ore futures market rose by 3.07%. The main contract I2409 closed at 874.Trade merchants are actively shipping goods and have a strong willingness to hold prices；Some steel mills purchased on demand. the market has a good trading atmosphere today. PBF at Shandong port dealt 882-888 yuan/mt; increased 0-5 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 905-910 yuan/mt; increased 5-10 yuan/mt over yesterday. This week, the top ten ports for iron ore still show a build-up of inventory; fines, concentrates, and lumps are in a surplus state; while pellets are in a destocking state. The pressure on iron ore remains. In addition, today's apparent demand and inventory data for building materials are average, and the price increase of iron ore is weakening.

DCE iron ore futures initially weak and then strong, The main contract I2409 closed at 888 .an increase of 6.48% throughout the day . The enthusiasm of traders for shipping is still acceptable; Steel mills purchase on demand. Today the overall market transaction atmosphere is acceptable. PBF at Shandong port dealt 865-885 yuan/mt; increased 0-15 yuan/mt from last Friday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 890-905 yuan/mt; increased 0-15 yuan/mt from last Friday. SMM shipping data shows that global shipping volume has declined by 11% this cycle, with both Australia and Pakistan experiencing a decline. The arrival volume has slightly increased. There has been a slight decline in supply, and there were reports in the afternoon of a train derailment at a mining site in Australia.

DCE iron ore futures rose largely today, the main contract closed 894.5, an increase of 1.07% throughout the day;Today's overall trading atmosphere is still relatively good, with the price of PB powder in Shandong region trading at 890-895 yuan/ton, an increase of 5-10 yuan/ton from last Friday. According to SMM shipping data, the global iron ore shipping volume is 31.12 million tons, an increase of 3.7% compared to the previous period. Among them, Australia shipped 17.37 million tons, a decrease of 6.7% compared to the previous period; Australia shipped 17.37 million tons to China, accounting for 90.5% of Australia's total shipping volume, an increase of 1% compared to the previous period. Brazil shipped 6.21 million tons, an increase of 3.3% compared to the previous period; overall shipping is showing a slightly loose state. Currently, macro news is more positive, but considering the weak profitability of steel mills, the willingness to lower prices may be stronger, and it is expected that iron ore prices will remain volatile in the short term.

text:
DCE iron ore futures market roseing sharply trends,The main contract I2409 closed at 921. an increase of 2.73% throughout the day .some traders were active to sell; Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchased on demand. Today the overall market transaction atmosphere is acceptable. PBF at Shandong port dealt 900-905 yuan/mt; increased 10-20 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 920-925 yuan/mt; increased 10-15 yuan/mt over yesterday. According to SMM research, on May 22nd, the operating rate of blast furnaces according to SMM statistics was 93.17%, an increase of 0.19% compared to the previous month. The utilization rate of blast furnace production capacity was 94.87%, an increase of 0.25% compared to the previous period. The daily average iron production of the sample steel plant was 2.2688 million tons, an increase of 5600 tons compared to the previous period. This week, the resumption of blast furnace production fell short of expectations, and the increment of molten iron has significantly narrowed. It is also estimated that there will be a slight decrease next week, and the production of molten iron has peaked, which has a weak impact on the driving force of mineral prices. However, policies on the real estate side have boosted market sentiment, with optimistic expectations for the future, stimulating a significant increase in the market. However, high iron ore port inventories may suppress the increase in spot prices, which may drag down the futures market. It is expected that the short-term upward space for ore prices will be limited, and they will mainly operate in high volatility.

text:
DCE iron ore futures open higher and go lower, fall sharply trends in the day by 1.09%. The main contract I2409 closed at 906.5.some traders were negative to sell; Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchasing enthusiasm is not high. today's overall market transaction atmosphere in general. PBF at Shandong port dealt 885-892 yuan/mt; decreased 10-15 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 910-915 yuan/mt; decreased 10-15 yuan/mt over yesterday. Based on the inventory data of the top ten main port iron ore varieties tracked by SMM, the total inventory this week still shows a cumulative trend; The concentrates and fines is more obvious; Lump is relatively stable; However, the cost-effectiveness of domestic pellets is relatively low, and the demand forforeign pellets is increasing, resulting in a decrease in inventory. Pig iron is already at a high level, and inventory is still in a state of accumulation, forming a strong suppression on mineral prices. Adding to the current high price of iron ore, some orders have made profits and left the market, leading to a volatile correction in iron ore prices. But currently, the demand for finished products and inventory data are performing well, and negative feedback from the industrial chain is difficult to form. It is expected that the short-term mining prices will fluctuate at high levels.

DCE iron ore futures continued to fluctuate in a day the main contract closed 908，an decrease of 0.44% throughout the day;Traders' quoting intentions are generally average, while steel mills are more cautious and wait-and-see, but overall purchasing intentions are still acceptable. The overall market transaction atmosphere is still good today. In Shandong, the transaction price of PB powder is in the range of 885-895 yuan/ton, which is basically stable compared to yesterday's prices; as of May 24th, SMM tracked a total of 144.40 million tons of inventory in 35 ports, an increase of 430,000 tons from last week and an increase of 20.02 million tons year-on-year; the average daily port clearance volume of imported ore is 2.893 million tons, a decrease of 84,000 tons compared to the previous month, an increase of 74,000 tons year-on-year, and port inventories are still relatively high, which puts pressure on ore prices to rise; Considering that the current profit of steel mills is in a loss-making state, there is a strong willingness to pressure ore prices, and it is expected that the price of iron ore will continue to fluctuate in the near future.

DCE iron ore futures fall today. The main contract I2409 closed at 899. an decrease of 2.27% throughout the day;some traders were negative to sell; Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchased on demand. today's overall market transaction atmosphere in general. PBF at Shandong port dealt 882-887 yuan/mt; decreased 0-10 yuan/mt from last Friday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 900-905 yuan/mt; decreased 10-15 yuan/mt from last Friday. According to SMM shipping data, the total global iron ore shipment was 34.43 million tons, an increase of 10.6% compared to the previous month. Among them, shipments from Australia and Brazil increased significantly month on month, while non mainstream shipments decreased slightly. But current data shows that the proportion of Australia sending to China has significantly decreased; In the future, the actual volume to China remained unchanged month on month. The total amount of iron ore delivered to the port by SMM China was 26.09 million tons, which remained unchanged compared to the previous month. Overall, there is still room for growth in the overall shipment volume of iron ore. Coupled with the short-term peak of molten iron production, there is a risk of slippage this week. It is expected that port inventory will continue to accumulate, suppressing spot prices. However, considering that the profitability of the steel mills is still acceptable, their production enthusiasm is good, and there is also support for ore prices from on-demand procurement. It is expected that there is not much downward space for ore prices in the short term, and they will mainly operate in a volatile manner.

DCE iron ore futures market falling sharply trends, the main contract closed 882.5. an decrease of 2.11% throughout the day;Part of the business quotation shipping mentality turn weak; Inquiries from steel mills have decreased, resulting in poor purchasing enthusiasm. total transactions remained insipid. PBF at Shandong port dealt 880-895 yuan/mt; prices are mixed today over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 900-905 yuan/mt; prices are mixed today over yesterday. The increase in market rumors today has caused interference to the market. Fundamentally speaking, the demand for iron ore has peaked, and as terminal demand gradually enters the off-season, it is estimated that the production of molten iron will decrease, resulting in weak growth in iron ore demand. But there will still be incremental growth on the supply side in the future, which will suppress mining prices. However, considering that the current demand for finished products is still good and supports the black series, it is estimated that there is not much downward space for mining prices in the short term, and they will operate in a narrow range of fluctuations.

DCE iron ore futures fall today, the main contract closed 891. an decrease of 1.11% throughout the day; Some tradersship according to market conditions; Some steel procurement more cautious, the continuation of a small number of multi-frequency procurement strategy. today's overall market transaction atmosphere in general. PBF at Shandong port dealt 875-885 yuan/mt; decreased 0-5 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 885-890 yuan/mt; decreased 0-10 yuan/mt over yesterday. This week, the pig iron production of SMM sample 190 steel mills slightly increased by 8800 tons. This week, three blast furnaces resumed production, and the planned maintenance of the blast furnaces was delayed, resulting in an increase in molten iron. In the future, as terminal demand enters the off-season, some steel mills have maintenance plans, and it is expected that the production of molten iron may shrink in June. However, considering the radiation of real estate policies to first tier cities and the relatively optimistic market sentiment, it is expected that mining prices will fluctuate at high levels in the short term.

DCE iron ore futures market falling sharply trends by 2.37%, the main contract closed 865. some traders were negative to sell,Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchasing enthusiasm is not high. total transactions remained insipid. PBF at Shandong port dealt 860-878 yuan/mt; decreased 10-20 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 875-885 yuan/mt; decreased 10-15 yuan/mt over yesterday. The sharp drop in iron ore prices today is mainly due to the impact of the crude steel control policy, coupled with a significant decrease in the demand for finished products, increasing the risk of inventory accumulation, and a shift in market sentiment. In addition, according to the inventory data of the top ten main port iron ore varieties tracked by SMM, the total inventory continues to accumulate, which also suppresses the price of iron ore. Therefore, in the short term, the pressure on ore prices is weak and fluctuates.

DCE iron ore futures market falling trends, the main contract closed 843.5. an decrease of 2.65% throughout the day;some traders were negative to sell, and some traders are unable to sell due to lockdowns; Some steel procurement more cautious, the continuation of a small number of multi-frequency procurement strategy. total transactions remained insipid. PBF at Shandong port dealt 840-850 yuan/mt;decreased 10-20 yuan/mt from last Friday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 860-870 yuan/mt; decreased 10-20 yuan/mt from last Friday. According to SMM shipping data, the total global iron ore shipment was 30.93 million tons, a decrease of 3.5 million tons compared to the previous month. The shipment volume to Australia has declined, but the shipment to Brazil and non mainstream mines has increased. Although the supply of iron ore has declined this week, the overall supply remains loose, suppressing iron ore prices. In addition, as the impact of the off-season deepens, the market is more concerned about terminal demand, and market sentiment has turned negative. Coupled with no positive macro news, iron ore prices continue to fluctuate weakly.

DCE iron ore futures continued to fall in a day，the main contract closed 834， an decrease of 2.11% throughout theday; some traders were negative to sell; Some steel mills purchased on demand. total transactions remained insipid. PBF at Shandong port dealt 830-840 yuan/mt; decreased 10 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 855-860 yuan/mt; decreased 5-10 yuan/mt over yesterday. According to SMM statistics, this week (June 1st to June 7th), the impact of blast furnace maintenance on molten iron was 1.0117 million tons, a decrease of 63100 tons compared to last week's maintenance. There is still a slight increase in the production of pig iron. However, in recent times, the macro positive sentiment has worsened, and the market's expectations for off-season demand have deviated. The negative feedback logic has advanced, leading to a conƟnuous decline in iron ore prices. In the short term, without any new posiƟve drivers, iron ore prices have continued to operate weakly and fluctuate. Considering the profitability of steel mills, the possibility of negative feedback occurring is extremely low, and the downward space for ore prices is limited.

DCE iron ore futures continued to fall in a day，the main contract closed 825， an decrease of 1.84% throughout the day;some traders were negative to sell; Some Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchasing enthusiasm is not high. total transactions remained insipid. PBF at Shandong port dealt 823-830 yuan/mt; decreased 5-10 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 850-855 yuan/mt; decreased 5 yuan/mt over yesterday. According to SMM research, on June 5th, the operating rate of blast furnaces according to SMM staƟsƟcs was 93.91%, an increase of 0.3% compared to the previous month. The daily average iron production of the sample steel plant was 2.2821 million tons, an increase of 4500 tons compared to the previous period. The production of pig iron in this cycle is still showing an upward trend. But the increase is relatively small. The overall demand for iron ore is still acceptable, which provides some support for ore prices. However, the current market sentiment is weak, and it is expected that short-term mining prices will face upward pressure and downward support, with narrow fluctuations running.

DCE iron ore futures market falling trends，the main contract closed 839.5, an increase of 0.96% throughout the day;some traders were active to sell; The inquiry from the steel mill is good, and the willingness to purchase has increased. today's overall market transaction atmosphere in general. PBF at Shandong port dealt 825-835 yuan/mt; increased 2-10 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 853-860 yuan/mt; increased 5 yuan/mt over yesterday. The total inventory of the top ten main port iron ore varieties tracked by SMM continues to accumulate, but the extent of accumulation has narrowed, with a large amount of coarse powder arriving at the port and inventory still accumulating; However, with the import of refined powder, the inventory of pellets and bulk ores has slightly decreased. Overall, the demand for iron ore is still acceptable. And today's steel table data meets market expectations, and the bearish sentiment in the market has improved, leading to a reversal in iron ore prices.

DCE iron ore futures open higher and go lower， futures market falling trends，the main contract closed 839.5，an increase of 0.72% throughout the day; Traders ship according to market conditions; The weekly procurement of steel mills has basically ended, with a cautious wait-and-see approach prevailing. today's overall market transaction atmosphere in general. PBF at Shandong port dealt 830-836 yuan/mt; increased 5 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 855-860 yuan/mt; the same as yesterday. As of June 7, the total inventory at the 35 ports tracked by SMM was 145.45 million mt, up 900,000 mt from a week ago and up 22.87 million mt YoY. The average daily shipments of imported ore from ports were 3.028 million mt, down 10,000 mt MoM but up 98,000 mt YoY. The high port inventory levels are suppressing the upward potential of iron ore prices. However, the demand for iron ore remains moderate, providing support for the prices. Iron ore prices are facing difficulƟes in moving up or down, and in the short term, they may continue to fluctuate within a range.

text:
DCE iron ore futures fell first and then rose today， the main contract closed 817，an increase of 0.93% throughout the day;Traders ship according to market conditions; Some steel procurement more cautious, the continuation of a small number of multi-frequency procurement strategy. Today the overall market transaction atmosphere is acceptable. PBF at Shandong port dealt 805-815 yuan/mt; the same as yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 830-840 yuan/mt; increased 0-5 yuan/mt over yesterday. the Federal Reserve's interest rate meeting released hawkish signals, reducing the likelihood of a rate cut. Aﬀected by this, coupled with poor macroeconomic data performance, market sentiment has become even more pessimistic, and the market has continuously fallen to new lows in the past two months. However, from the perspective of industry data, rainfall and high temperatures have led to a continued weakening of terminal demand, and the total inventory of steel has begun to accumulate. However, the magnitude of the accumulation is relatively small, which is in line with market expectations. The pessimistic sentiment has eased, driving a rebound in the market. Considering that the fundamentals of iron ore are still relatively weak, it is expected that it will be difficult to reverse in the short term and will continue to show a weak and volatile trend.

DCE iron ore futures rose largely today，the main contract closed 827.5，an increase of 1.97% throughout the day; some traderswere active to sell； pproaching the weekend and with rising market conditions, steel mills have weakened their willingness to purchase；today's overall market transaction atmosphere in general. PBF at Shandong port dealt 817-830 yuan/mt; increased 10-20 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 835-845 yuan/mt; increased 5-15 yuan/mt over yesterday. As of June 14th, the total inventory of 35 ports tracked by SMM was 145.23 million tons, a month on month decrease of 220000 tons and a year-on-year increase of 20.58 million tons; The daily average port clearance volume of imported mines was 2.995 million tons, a decrease of 33000 tons compared to the previous month and an increase of 18000 tons compared to the same period last year. According to SMM tracking, there has been a significant decline in the number of arrivals due to the high pressure on ports this cycle; In terms of port clearance, steel mills mainly rely on on-demand procurement, and iron ore prices fluctuate greatly, resulting in weak purchasing enthusiasm and low levels of inventory in the factory. Considering the recent release of pessimistic sentiment and the improvement of market sentiment, coupled with market rumors of favoritism, mining prices continue to fluctuate strongly.

DCE iron ore futures open higher and go lower， falling trends in the day， the main contract closed 813，an decreaseof 1.63% throughout the day; Some traders are closed and unable to ship, while others have average enthusiasm for shipping；Some steel procurement more cautious, the continuation of a small number of multi-frequency procurement strategy . total transactions remained insipid. PBF at Shandong port dealt 810 yuan/mt; decreased 7-20 yuan/mt from last Friday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 825-830 yuan/mt; decreased 10-15 yuan/mt from last Friday. Today, iron ore prices experienced another pullback, mainly following Friday's bearish M1 data; In addition, the one-year MLF bid interest rate announced by the central bank is 2.50%, which is unchanged from before and lower than market expectations. Affected by this, the market has declined slightly. From the fundamental perspective of iron ore itself, last week, SMM's global iron ore shipments totaled 27.85 million tons, a decrease of 8.6% compared to the previous week. Shipping volumes from Australia, Brazil, and non mainstream mines have all declined. The arrival volume was 20.54 million tons, an increase of 6.65% compared to the previous month. But it is still lower than the same period last year. The pressure on iron ore supply has eased to some extent, and iron ore prices still have support, with limited room for short-term exploration.

DCE iron ore futures continued to ﬂuctuate in a day，Significant drop at the end. the main contract closed 824，an decrease of 0.36%throughout the day; some traders were negative to sell；Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchased on demand. today's overall market transaction atmosphere in general . PBF at Shandong port dealt 820-830 yuan/mt; the same as yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 840-850 yuan/mt; the same as yesterday. According to the SMM survey, as of June 19, the operating rate of blast furnaces surveyed by SMM was 93.91%, ﬂat WoW. The capacity utilization rate was 95.78%, down 0.07% WoW. The average daily pig iron output of the sample steel mills was 2.2905 million mt, down 1,800 mt.according to SMM tracking, local steel mills' profits are recovering. Next week, there will still be blast furnaces resuming production as planned, and there will be a significant increase in molten iron; There is still an increase in demand for iron ore. Although there have been continuous reports of crude steel production restrictions recently, in the short term, the actual impact is limited, and it is expected that the iron ore price range will ﬂuctuate.

text:
DCE iron ore ﬂuctuated repeatedly， the main contract closed 824.5，an decrease of0.36% throughout the day; Traders followed the market trend to sell; steel mills were mostly cautious and not very active in purchasing. total transactions remained insipid. PBF at Shandong port dealt 825-830 yuan/mt; increased 5 yuan/mt over yesterday.. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 835-850 yuan/mt; increased 5 yuan/mt over yesterday. Today, the apparent demand for steel slightly rebounded, indicating that end-user demand, although in the oﬀ-season, still shows resilience. However, the overall market sentiment remains pessimistic. Additionally, there have been many recent market rumors, making it difficult to distinguish between true and false information. With no clear direction in the fundamentals, prices are easily swayed by news. Iron ore prices face pressure from above and support from below, and in the short term, they may continue to ﬂuctuate within a range.

DCE iron ore futures traded sideways. the main contract closed 801，remaining flat throughout the day.; Traders' enthusiasmfor quoting prices remained weak, and steel mills restocked as needed. today's overall market transaction atmosphere in general. PBF at Shandong port dealt 795-800 yuan/mt; the same as yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 810-815 yuan/mt; the same as yesterday. According to the [SMM Weekly Maintenance Statistics], this week the impact of blast furnace maintenance on pig iron output was 1.0221 million mt, down 31,900 mt from the previous week. In the short term, pig iron output continues to show a slight upward trend and has reached a relatively high YoY level, providing some support for iron ore prices. However, recent heavy rains and high temperatures in many regions have weakened demand for finished steel. Coupled with a lack of positive news on the macro front, iron ore prices are expected to continue to fluctuate weakly in the short term. According to the SMM weekly maintenance statistics, from June 22 to June 28, the impact of blast furnace maintenance on pig iron output was 1.0221 million mt, down 31,900 mt from the previous week. text:
DCE iron ore futures market roseing sharply trends. the main contract closed 826，an increase of 3.38% throughout the day;some traders were active to sell, and Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchased on demand. Today the overall market transaction atmosphere is acceptable . PBF at Shandong port dealt 805-820 yuan/mt; increased 5-15 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 825-835 yuan/mt; increased 10-15 yuan/mt over yesterday. According to SMM research, on June 26th, the blast furnace operating rate recorded by SMM was 94.50%, an increase of 0.59% compared to the previous month. The utilization rate of blast furnace production capacity was 96.33%, an increase of 0.55% compared to the previous period. The daily average iron production of the sample steel plant is 2.3025 million tons, an increase of 12000 tons compared to the previous month. And there is still room for growth next week. The increase in demand for iron ore provides strong support for ore prices. Meanwhile, there are market rumors that the country may introduce relevant measures to stabilize long-term investment, thereby enhancing market confidence. This series of factors together have led to a significant increase in mineral prices.

DCE iron ore futures rose in the day. the main contract closed 819，an increase of 1.24% throughout the day;some traders quotation is still stronger, and Some steel mills purchased on demand. today's overall market transaction atmosphere in general. PBF at Shandong port dealt 815-820 yuan/mt; increased 0-5 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 830-835 yuan/mt; increased 0-5 yuan/mt over yesterday. SMM's total national construction steel inventory contnued to increase by 1.21% month on month. The total inventory of hot coils increased slightly by 9600 tons. During the off-season of terminal demand, the accumulation of steel inventory is sƟll acceptable. But the significant increase in building material production this week has raised concerns in the market about the increasing slope of future inventory accumulation. In addition, the fundamentals of iron ore itself are in a state of high supply, high demand, and high inventory. In the case of weak terminal demand, there is insufficient upward drive and short-term or narrow fluctuations.

DCE iron ore futures fluctuated strongly. the main contract closed 840，an increase of 2.5% throughout the day;Traders were actively selling; steel mills' willingness to purchase was average, mainly restocking as needed. total transactions remained insipid. PBF at Shandong port dealt 830-840 yuan/mt; increased 10-15 yuan/mt from last Friday.. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 845-850 yuan/mt; increased 10-15 yuan/mt from last Friday. According to SMM data, global iron ore shipments were 35.12 million mt, down 1.1% MoM. Among them, shipments from Australia were 19.67 million mt, down 6.6% MoM; shipments from Brazil were 8.74 million mt, up 8.6% MoM. Despite the June PMI index being lower than expected, the upcoming Third Plenary Session and the strengthened expectations of macro policies improved market senƟment, driving iron ore prices to fluctuate upwards. However, given the current poor profits of steel mills and some mills planning blast furnace maintenance, it is expected that the upward trend of iron ore prices will face significant resistance in the short term and may continue to fluctuate.

DCE iron ore futures market falling sharply trends. the main contract closed 825.5. an decrease of 3.34% throughout the day;some traders were negative to sell. Some steel mills few inquiries ,and purchased on demand, total transactions remained insipid. PBF at Shandong port dealt 820-825 yuan/mt; decreased 10-20 yuan/mt from last Friday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 835 yuan/mt; decreased 15-20 yuan/mt from last Friday. Last week, SMM's global iron ore shipments totaled 34.32 million tons, a decrease of 2.3% compared to the previous week. Both Australia and Brazil experienced a decline in shipments. The total amount of iron ore arriving at SMM China's port was 24 million tons, a decrease of 6.03% compared to the previous month. Overall, the shipment and arrival of iron ore are still at a high level; Based on the maintenance situation of SMM's blast furnace this week, it is estimated that the molten iron will slightly decline; Iron ore inventory may continue to accumulate. In addition, due to the off-season of terminal demand, market concerns about demand remain, resulting in a significant decline in the market. However, as important meetings approach, the market still has certain expectations to support mining prices, making it difficult to open up short-term downward space and may continue to fluctuate.

DCE iron ore futures tight by 0.48% in the day. the main contract closed 834. an decrease of 3.34% throughout the day;Traders have average enthusiasm for shipping and tend to ship according to market trends; Some steel mills purchase on demand. The overall market transaction atmosphere today is average. today's overall market transaction atmosphere in general. PBF at Shandong port dealt 825-835 yuan/mt; increased 5 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 845-850 yuan/mt; increased 5-10 yuan/mt over yesterday. According to SMM statistics, this week (July 6th to July 12th), the impact of blast furnace maintenance on molten iron was 978200 tons, an increase of 37500 tons compared to last week's maintenance. The impact of blast furnace maintenance on molten iron next week (July 13th to July 19th) is 1.0398 million tons, an increase of 61600 tons compared to this week. The production of molten iron has slightly declined, but the proportion is relatively small. Based on the current profit and inventory situation of steel mills, the conditions for negative feedback have not been met. The short-term production of molten iron is still at a high level, and the demand for iron ore still supports prices. It is expected that the short-term fluctuations in ore prices will be mainly narrow.

DCE iron ore futures continued to trend in a day. the main contract closed 813. an decrease of 1.81% throughout the day;Some traders do not sell. Some steel mills are lowering prices for procurement. total transactions remained insipid. PBF at Shandong port dealt 810-820 yuan/mt; decreased 15-20 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 820-830 yuan/mt; decreased 15-20 yuan/mt over yesterday. According to SMM research, on July 10th, the operating rate of blast furnaces according to SMM statistics was 94.36%, which remained stable month on month. The utilization rate of blast furnace production capacity is 96.38%, a decrease of 0.05% compared to the previous period. The daily average iron production of the sample steel plant was 2.3045 million tons, a decrease of 0.1 million tons compared to the previous period. At present, steel mills generally have poor profits, and coupled with the deepening impact of the off-season on steel, the market expects the demand for finished products to further weaken. The expectation of significant meetings is expected to weaken, and it is expected that short-term mining prices may continue to operate weakly.

DCE iron ore futures has turned from weak to strong, the main contract closed 828. an increase of 0.79% throughout the day;some traders ere active to sell,. Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchased on demand. today's overall market transaction atmosphere in general. PBF at Shandong port dealt 815-830 yuan/mt; increased 5-10 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 835-845 yuan/ mt; increased 10-15 yuan/mt over yesterday. Today's building materials demand is expected to rebound, leading to a slight decrease in inventory. Exceeding market expectations, although the demand for hot coil watches and inventory performance are weak, market sentiment has improved. Due to the limited reduction of molten iron in steel mills, the demand for iron ore still provides support for ore prices. The valuation of mineral prices is relatively weak, with limited downward space in the future. However, during the off-season of demand, there is still a risk of weakening profits for steel mills, and the upward driving force of mineral prices is insufficient. In the short term, it may continue to fluctuate within a certain range.

DCE iron ore futures continued to fluctuate in a day, the main contract closed 827. an increase of 0.3% throughout the day;some traders according to market conditions. Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchasing enthusiasm is not high. today's overall market transaction atmosphere in general. PBF at Shandong port dealt 820-825 yuan/mt; ; increased 5 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 840-845 yuan/mt; increased 5 yuan/mt over yesterday. As of July 12th, the total inventory of 35 ports tracked by SMM was 146.22 million tons, an increase of 180000 tons month on month and 24.85 million tons year-on-year; The daily average port clearance of imported mines is 3.025 million tons, a decrease of 0.4 million tons compared to the previous period and a decrease of 27000 tons compared to the same period last year. This week, the pig iron began to decline, dragging down the decrease in port clearance volume; Port inventory continues to accumulate and mineral prices are under pressure, with insufficient upward momentum. Pay attention to whether next week's meeting will bring favorable policies.

DCE iron ore futures rose largely today, the main contract closed 834. an increase of 1.03% throughout the day; some traders accordingto market conditions. Steel mills mainly adopt a wait-and-see approach, with fewer inquiries. total transactions remained insipid. PBF at Shandong port dealt 825- 835 yuan/mt; increased 5-10 yuan/mt from last Friday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 840-845 yuan/mt; increased 0-5 yuan/mt from last Friday. Last week, SMM shipped a total of 28.01 million tons of iron ore globally, a decrease of 18.4% compared to the previous week. Among them, Australia shipped 15.45 million tons, a significant decrease of 21.1% compared to the previous period; Brazil shipped 7.29 million tons, a decrease of 8.9% compared to the previous period; After the end of season rush, coupled with the decline in mineral prices, some mines have reduced their shipments. Due to the impact of fires and mine maintenance, global shipping volume has declined. Supporting the formation of mineral prices. But in late June, the shipment volume was high, and the arrival volume of iron ore at the port increased by 11.33% month on month. The overall supply remains loose. During important meetings, market news may cause emoƟonal disturbances, and it is expected that mining prices will fluctuate frequently this week.

DCE iron ore futures rose largely today, the main contract closed 834. an increase of 1.03% throughout the day;some traders according to market conditions. Steel mills mainly adopt a wait-and-see approach, with fewer inquiries. total transactions remained insipid. PBF at Shandong port dealt 825- 835 yuan/mt; increased 5-10 yuan/mt from last Friday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 840-845 yuan/mt; increased 0-5 yuan/mt from last Friday. Last week, SMM shipped a total of 28.01 million tons of iron ore globally, a decrease of 18.4% compared to the previous week. Among them, Australia shipped 15.45 million tons, a significant decrease of 21.1% compared to the previous period; Brazil shipped 7.29 million tons, a decrease of 8.9% compared to the previous period; After the end of season rush, coupled with the decline in mineral prices, some mines have reduced their shipments. Due to the impact of fires and mine maintenance, global shipping volume has declined. Supporting the formation of mineral prices. But in late June, the shipment volume was high, and the arrival volume of iron ore at the port increased by 11.33% month on month. The overall supply remains loose. During important meetings, market news may cause emotional disturbances, and it is expected that mining prices will fluctuate frequently this week.

DCE iron ore futures cotinued in the morning,v and droped in the afternoon. the main contract closed 805. an decrease of 2.66%throughout the day; Some traders are unable to sell their products due to market closures. Some steel mills purchased on demand, and the purchasing enthusiasm has slightly increased . PBF at Shandong port dealt 805-825 yuan/mt; decreased 10-20 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 825-840 yuan/mt; decreased 5-20 yuan/mt over yesterday. On July 17th, SMM reported a blast furnace operating rate of 94.16%, a decrease of 0.2% compared to the previous month. The utilization rate of blast furnace capacity was 95.97%, a decrease of 0.41% compared to the previous period. The average daily iron production of the sample steel plant was 2.2995 million tons, a decrease of 0.5 million tons compared to the previous period. The demand for iron ore continues to weaken. In addition, there has been another decline in terminal data during the off-season; During the important meetings, there were no positive policies announced, and the market sentiment was relatively pessimisti. The price of iron ore has experienced a significant decline.

DCE iron ore futures fall today. the main contract closed 811.5. an decrease of 0.92% throughout the day; sometraders were negative to sell,. Some steel mills purchased on demand. PBF at Shandong port dealt 805-810 yuan/mt; the same as yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 825-830 yuan/mt; the same as yesterday. This week's hot roll and building materials inventory data show some divergence. The total inventory of hot coils continues to increase, but the growth rate has slightly slowed down. However, due to the impact of the new national standard, the speed of destocking building materials inventory has accelerated. In addition, after the decline in iron ore prices, steel mills have increased their procurement of essential goods, which has provided support for mineral prices. However, considering that there were no unexpected favorable policies introduced during the important meeting, expectations fell through; The overlapping industry is in the off-season, and it is expected that iron ore prices may continue to fluctuate at a low level.

DCE iron ore futures fall today. the main contract closed 804.5. an decrease of 0.19% throughout the day;some traders were negative to sell, Some steel procurement more cautious, the continuation of a small number of multi-frequency procurement strategy. PBF at Shandong port dealt 795- 805 yuan/mt; decreased 5 yuan/mt over yesterday.. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 825-830 yuan/mt; decreased 5 yuan/mt over yesterday. As of July 12th, the total inventory of 35 ports tracked by SMM was 147.59 million tons, an increase of 1.38 million tons month on month and 25.55 million tons year-on-year; The daily average port clearance of imported mines was 3.018 million tons, a decrease of 7000 tons compared to the previous period and a decrease of 3000 tons compared to the same period last year. The price decline and weak purchasing willingness of steel mills have dragged down the daily average port clearance volume, resulting in the accumulation of port inventory suppressing iron ore prices. Considering the low season of terminal demand and lack of market confidence, short-term mineral prices may continue to fluctuate weakly.

DCE iron ore futures fall today. the main contract closed 804.5. an decrease of 0.19% throughout the day; some traders were negativeto sell, Some steel procurement more cautious, the continuation of a small number of mulƟ-frequency procurement strategy. PBF at Shandong port dealt 795- 805 yuan/mt; decreased 5 yuan/mt over yesterday.. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 825-830 yuan/mt; decreased 5 yuan/mt over yesterday. As of July 12th, the total inventory of 35 ports tracked by SMM was 147.59 million tons, an increase of 1.38 million tons month on month and 25.55 million tons year-on-year; The daily average port clearance of imported mines was 3.018 million tons, a decrease of 7000 tons compared to the previous period and a decrease of 3000 tons compared to the same period last year. The price decline and weak purchasing willingness of steel mills have dragged down the daily average port clearance volume, resulting in the accumulation of port inventory suppressing iron ore prices. Considering the low season of terminal demand and lack of market confidence, short-term mineral prices may continue to fluctuate weakly.

DCE iron ore futures market falling sharply trends by 3.43%. the main contract closed 774.5. some traders do not sell,Some steel mills tended to be wait-and-see, and purchasing enthusiasm is not high. PBF at Shandong port dealt 775-790 yuan/mt; decreased 20-30 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 815-820 yuan/mt; decreased 25-30 yuan/mt over yesterday. According to SMM statistics, the amount of molten iron affected by blast furnace maintenance this week (July 20th to July 26th) was 1.0885 million tons, an increase of 4100 tons compared to last week's maintenance impact. Due to the recent transition of new and old national standards for rebar, the market selling situation has worsened and panic has intensified. The price of threads has dropped significantly. The losses of steel mills have intensified, and some steel mills have increased their blast furnace maintenance plans in August. The decrease in iron production has dragged down the demand for iron ore. Due to the failure of macroeconomic expectations, mineral prices have dropped significantly. Short term or weak oscillation operation is the main trend.

DCE iron ore futures fall today by 3.43%. the main contract closed 775.5. some traders were negative to sell, Some steel mills tended tobe wait-and-see, with a focus on purchasing at lower prices. PBF at Shandong port dealt 775-780 yuan/mt; increased 0-3 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 790-795 yuan/mt; the same as yesterday. On July 24th, SMM reported a blast furnace operaƟng rate of 93.61%, a decrease of 0.55% compared to the previous month. The utilization rate of blast furnace capacity was 95.52%, a decrease of 0.45% compared to the previous period. The average daily iron production of the sample steel plant was 2.2901 million tons, a decrease of 9400 tons compared to the previous period. Recently, the price of threaded steel has dropped significantly, causing severe losses for steel mills. Some steel mills plan to overhaul their blast furnaces in August, which may lead to a continued decline in iron production. However, considering the approaching end of the month, the market still has expectations for the Politburo meeting, and it is expected that iron ore prices may have a short-term chance of bottoming out and rebounding.

DCE iron ore futures continued to fall today %. the main contract closed 764.5. an decrease of 1.55% throughout the day; sometraders were negative to sell, Some steel purchased on demand. PBF at Shandong port dealt 765 yuan/mt; decreased 10-15 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 780-785 yuan/mt; decreased 10 yuan/mt over yesterday. According to today's inventory and apparent demand data, the demand for the five major materials has all declined. At present, it is in the off-season, with frequent high temperature and rainstorm warnings, the market estimates that the terminal demand may further weaken in the future. In addition, the alternation of new and old national standards has a significant impact on the rebar market, with strong selling sentiment and widespread pessimism, leading to a sustained decline in iron ore prices.

DCE iron ore futures rebounded aŌer stopping their decline.. the main contract closed 779. an increase of 1.5% throughout the day;Some traders are shipping as they go; Steel mills are cautiously observing, with a weak willingness to purchase. The overall market transaction atmosphere is sluggish today. PBF at Shandong port dealt 775-780 yuan/mt; increased 10-15 yuan/mt over yesterday. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 794-800 yuan/mt; increased 10 yuan/mt over yesterday. As of July 26, the total inventory at the 35 ports tracked by SMM was 149.05 million mt, up 1.46 million mt MoM and up 28.08 million mt YoY. The average daily pick-up volume from ports for imported ore was 3.119 million mt, up 101,000 mt MoM and up 92,000 mt YoY. Iron ore prices fell, and steel mills restocked at low levels, driving an increase in pick-up volume from ports. This indicates that iron ore demand remains strong, providing some support for ore prices. Additionally, market pessimism was somewhat digested during the week, and iron ore prices rebounded. However, enduser demand is still in the off-season, and it is expected that although ore prices may rebound next week, the rebound will be limited, with prices mainly fluctuating at low levels.
